prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this empty isometric room into Ren's secluded plum-and-sword residence. Preserve EXACT camera, floor diamond shape, wall heights, floor-wall boundary, outer silhouette, transparent margins and empty navigable floor. Replace pink Victorian walls with warm ivory plaster, dark walnut slim beams and understated antique-gold details. Replace pastel drapery with a circular moon window high on left wall, with delicate crimson plum blossoms outside and restrained jade green fabric trim. Right wall high up: small ink-style serpentine dragon wall hanging and a horizontal rack holding a sheathed sword, all decor attached to walls, no floor objects. Floor becomes rich medium-dark walnut boards with subtle warm amber illumination. Calm elegant East Asian fantasy retreat, cozy not ominous, premium painted chibi game asset matching reference level of detail. NO furniture, rug, floor objects, people, text, labels, UI, roof, foreground walls. Real alpha transparency outside room. Landscape same composition as input, no exterior cast shadow. Important: do not shift the floor vertices; these coordinates are used for navigation.

Row1 center: jade green cushioned wooden daybed/sofa, dark walnut arms and legs, ivory lumbar pillow with understated dragon embroidery, same seat/back position as reference. Row1 right: tall dark walnut and ivory wardrobe, jade panels, antique gold fittings, tiny plum emblem, same closed double-door silhouette as reference. Row2 left: low dark walnut tea table, celadon teapot and ivory teacup, same oval tabletop. Row2 center: open dark walnut travel chest with FOUR OPEN WOODEN FLAPS arranged just like reference box, ivory plum insignia front; empty visible dark interior for character hiding, same front wall height. Row2 right: small jade green and ivory embroidered temari ball with thin gold interlace and crimson plum accent, no tassels. No hearts, bows, pink fabrics or extra objects. Isolated matching atlas with TRUE ALPHA transparent background, absolutely no blurred or colored backdrops, no shadows outside objects, text, borders or characters. Keep six clear large transparent gaps and clean crisp edges. This is one production game atlas.
